questions.prompt: The first beat of this bar shows an ornament written out in full. Which sign could replace it?
questions.explanation: The written-out notes are an appoggiatura: a leaning note that takes time from the main note.

whyWrong.1: That sign is an upper mordent: the note, the note above, the note (quickly).
whyWrong.2: That sign is a lower mordent: the note, the note below, the note (quickly).
